sentences.text: 3  For R-13 : Mr.Aswin  for Mr.M.Rajarajan  For R-21 : Mr.V.R.Shanmuganathan  ORDER (Order of the Court was made by S.M.SUBRAMANIAM, J.)

The Writ of Mandamus has been instituted seeking direction to the respondents 1 to 20 to take combined action to secure and safeguard the properties of 21st respondent temple as well as to rectify the defects forthwith mentioned in the report dated 29.09.2018 of 10th respondent by considering the petitioner's representation dated 24.09.2018 as well as the reports dated 29.09.2018, 03.10.2018, 03.10.2018 and 03.10.2018 submitted by the respondents 6, 10, 12 and 14 respectively.

2. The District Collector, Tenkasi District is suo motu impleaded as the 22nd respondent in the Writ Petition in view of the bifurcation of Tirunelveli https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on:
27/06/2025 05:00:16 pm ) District as Tirunelveli and Tenkasi, since the Writ Petition has been instituted prior to bifurcation of Tirunelveli District.
3. The subject temple, namely, Arulmigu Sankara Narayana Swamy Thirukoil is situated at Sankarankoil.
The petitioner in person would articulate by stating that the properties belonging to the temple are encroached upon and no action has been taken by the competent authority.
Pursuant to the complaint submitted by the petitioner, a Joint Committee Meeting was convened in the presence of the Tahsildar, Tirunelveli in the year 2018 and Minutes of the meeting are recorded.
Despite the fact that actions are proposed to be initiated, till today, no action has been taken.
4. This Court is of the considered view that the temple properties are to be protected and to be maintained in accordance with the provisions of the Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Act.

entities.text: Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Department is obligated to follow the procedures to evict the encroachers and utilise the property for the benefit of the temple and the devotees in the manner contemplated under the Act and Rules.

5. Since no action has been taken for several years, the District Collector, Tenkasi District is directed to convene a fresh Joint Committee Meeting to sort https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 27/06/2025 05:00:16 pm ) out the issues relating to the properties belonging to Arulmigu Sankara Narayana Swamy Thirukoil and initiate all appropriate enforcement actions to resume the properties and utilise the same for the benefit of the temple and to implement the temple schemes,
etc.
The said meeting is directed to be convened within a period of six (6) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

The decisions taken by the Committee for resumption of temple lands are to be strictly acted upon so as to ensure that the temple properties are protected in accordance with the Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Act and Rules.
